name: Expense Capture — Papra → Claude → Google Sheets

nodes.name: Papra Webhook
nodes.notes: Copy the generated webhook URL into Papra's webhook settings (Settings → Webhooks). Trigger: document.created

nodes.name: Fetch Document Metadata
nodes.notes: Adjust $json.body.documentId to match the actual field name in Papra's webhook payload. Credential: add header 'Authorization' with value 'Bearer <your-papra-api-key>'.

nodes.name: Fetch File Binary
nodes.notes: Adjust $json.fileUrl to match the field name Papra returns for the download URL. If Papra returns a pre-signed URL, remove the credential reference.

nodes.name: Call Claude API
nodes.notes: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in n8n Variables (Settings → Variables). Alternatively, create an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic API Key' and switch authentication to genericCredentialType.

nodes.name: Append Row to Sheet
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID with your sheet's ID (from the URL). Create a sheet named 'Expenses' with column headers matching the field names output by Parse Claude Response.

nodes.name: Tag Document as Processed
nodes.notes: Adjust the PATCH endpoint and body shape to match Papra's actual API for updating document tags.
